name: The majority voted in favour of a motion to *disagree* with an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2021-11-22.131.1) introduced by Indi MP [Helen Haines](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/indi/helen_haines) (Independent), which means the amendment failed. ### Amendment text > *That all words after "whilst" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words:* > > *"noting the importance of this reform, the House:* > > *(1) notes the Government broke with convention and introduced a significant addition to this bill, tripling it in size within a matter of hours, and preventing the crossbench from having an opportunity to review, contemplate or be briefed on the amended bill;* > > *(2) notes that if the Government wanted to truly level the playing field when it comes to political donations, it could lower the AEC disclosure threshold from the current rate of $14,500 to $1,000; and* > > *(3) calls on the Government to postpone the second reading vote on this bill until another sitting day, as is the convention with new bills".*
